text.title: Hexer's Hollow
text.body: A rogue blood-hexer conducts foul rites deep within Hexer's Hollow. Breach the cavern sanctuary, cut down his bone guardians, and bring an end to his maledictions.
text.obj.0: Defeat Hexer Saelen in the northern sanctuary
text.msg.1: Keep water charms ready—Saelen and his coven rely on fire imps and frost.
text.msg.2: Saelen is bleeding—his hidden acolytes are pouring out of the shrine!
text.msg.3: Hexer Saelen falls. His staff shatters on the flagstones.
text.win: Hexer Saelen is defeated and the briar coven scatters.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen in the hollow.
